Name: Toucapir
Author: Campaigner
Description:
Gonna keep it simple; this mod changes your cat from a cute little orange furball into an unholy abomination with a skunk stripe, toucan head, and a black body. Why did I make this? I have no idea. It just happened when I was playing around in Photoshop.

To install, drag the "Content" folder into your Stardew Valley directory. It'll overwrite the cat.xnb file, so if you want to undo this, BACK UP THE XNB FILE.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
